# Story 25.3: E2E regression test that dms-base-table columns spread to fill the row width

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want an e2e regression test asserting that on a wide viewport (1920px) the Universe table's columns spread to fill the available row width — distributing spare space across columns rather than leaving unused space after the last column —
so that the "columns stopped spreading" regression is locked in at the browser level and any future change that re-disables flex-grow (or otherwise stops cells from expanding) fails CI.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A new e2e spec navigates to `/global/universe` on a 1920×1080 viewport, logs in, waits for the table + first body row, and filters to the known seeded row `TESTEQ1` (the shared e2e SQLite DB accumulates rows across runs — filter instead of assuming which rows are present).
2. The spec measures each rendered header cell's width via `getBoundingClientRect().width` for every data column in the Universe table (`vol`, `svol`, `symbol`, `risk_group`, `distribution`, `distributions_per_year`, `yield_percent`, `avg_purchase_yield_percent`, `last_price`, `ex_date`, `most_recent_sell_date`, `most_recent_sell_price`, `position`, `expired`, `actions`) and compares each to its configured minimum from `global-universe.columns.ts` (50, 50, 80, 90, 120, 80, 90, 120, 90, 230, 110, 110, 140, 100, 70 — sum 1530px).
3. The spec asserts the **total growth** across all data columns is positive and substantial: `sum(renderedWidth − configuredMin) > GROW_THRESHOLD_PX` (threshold ≥ 20px), proving spare row width was distributed across columns (spread to fill) rather than left as empty space after the last column. Under the regression (`flex: 0 1 auto`, no grow) this sum is ~0 and the assertion fails.
4. The test runs on Chromium + Firefox with no `.skip`/`.only`, and existing invariants stay green — header/body parity within 1px (`base-table-two-region-regression.spec.ts`), ex-date ≥ 200px floor (`universe-ex-date-column-width.spec.ts`), and scroll/no-overflow behavior (`base-table-layout-regression.spec.ts`).

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Scaffold the e2e spec with login + navigation + seeded-row filter.
  - [ ] 1.1 Create `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/universe-column-spread-fill.spec.ts` using a 1920×1080 viewport (`test.use({ viewportSize: ... })`), mirroring the setup in `universe-ex-date-column-width.spec.ts`.
  - [ ] 1.2 In `beforeEach`, log in, go to `/global/universe`, wait for `dms-base-table` + first `.dms-body-row[role="row"]`, and filter via `input[placeholder="Search Symbol"]` to the seeded row `TESTEQ1`.
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Measure rendered vs configured column widths.
  - [ ] 2.1 Define a `{ field, min }` map for the 15 Universe data columns sourced from `global-universe.columns.ts` (sum 1530px).
  - [ ] 2.2 For each column, read the header cell width via `mat-header-cell[data-column="<field>"]` → `getBoundingClientRect().width`.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3): Assert total growth proves spread-to-fill.
  - [ ] 3.1 Compute `totalGrowth = sum(renderedWidth − min)` across all data columns and assert it is greater than `GROW_THRESHOLD_PX` (≥ 20px). Add a descriptive failure message including the per-column rendered vs configured values.
- [ ] Task 4 (AC: #4): Confirm cross-browser + no regression in existing suites.
  - [ ] 4.1 Run the new spec on Chromium and Firefox; confirm it passes with Story 25.2 landed (`flex: 1 1 auto`).
  - [ ] 4.2 Re-run `base-table-two-region-regression.spec.ts`, `universe-ex-date-column-width.spec.ts`, and `base-table-layout-regression.spec.ts` to confirm header/body parity, the ex-date floor, and scroll/no-overflow invariants still hold.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** Story 10.3 set `flex: 0 1 auto` on both cell classes so configured widths render exactly; that disabled flex-grow, so at wide viewports the columns occupy only their configured width (~1530px + select) and leave unused space to the right — they no longer spread over the full table width. Story 25.2 restores `flex: 1 1 auto`; this e2e test locks that in at the browser level so a future change that re-disables grow fails CI.
- **Assertion design:** asserting *total growth* (sum of rendered − configured) rather than per-column strict inequality is robust to flex's proportional distribution and sub-pixel rounding — with ~1530px basis against a ~1600px+ available row at 1920px, grow distributes the spare across all columns, so total growth comfortably exceeds 20px. Under no-grow the sum is ~0 → fails cleanly. This avoids depending on exact row-content-box measurement (borders/padding) and works identically in Chromium + Firefox.
- **Configured-min source:** read the numbers from `apps/dms-material/src/app/global/global-universe/global-universe.columns.ts` when writing the spec; if a column's width changes later, update the map here too (the test is Universe-specific by design — it exercises one real consumer of `dms-base-table`).
- **Viewport:** 1920px is required so there is guaranteed spare row width beyond the 1530px basis; at narrower viewports shrink dominates and growth could be ~0, which would make the assertion flaky. Keep the wide viewport (same rationale as `universe-ex-date-column-width.spec.ts`).
- **Do NOT** modify production SCSS or component code in this story — e2e test only. The fix is Story 25.2; this story must be written to pass against that fix and fail without it.
